question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4.
solution:
The solution is **the**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4, " Large crowds daily (3)_______ up the hill to see through (4)_______ telescope." is the.
 
• Large crowds daily climbed up the hill to see through the telescope.
 
• Articles are used before nouns. We use the when referring to something specific and A and An when referring to something in general.
 
• Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The above-given options contain **articles.**
